### Tender Words in the Wilderness - The Crosswalk Devotional - December 13
Author: Deidre Braley
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/tender-words-in-the-wilderness-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Hosea 2:14
Points:
- People easily turn toward worldly idols, mistakenly believing they provide satisfaction and joy.
- Pursuing worldly substitutes inevitably ends in emptiness and spiritual heartache.
- God allows periods of loss and desert wanderings so believers realize that idols cannot sustain them.
- Rather than responding with harsh anger, the Lord draws His wayward people into solitude to speak gently to them.
- Believers are invited to turn away from false gods and find healing rest in God's steadfast love.

### You Are Pursued in Love - The Crosswalk Devotional - October 1
Author: Jennifer Slattery
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/you-are-pursued-in-love-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Hosea 2:14-16
Points:
- Human betrayal causes deep pain, yet God bridges the canyon of human failure with relentless grace.
- Israel repeatedly credited false idols for God's blessings, but God responded with redeeming pursuit.
- The Lord leads His people into wilderness seasons to rebuild reliance, trust, and intimate connection.
- God promises to turn places of trouble and grief into doors of renewed hope.
- The Lord desires a relationship grounded in mutual love and trust rather than fearful servitude.
